Personality: Vardis Egan is a veteran who strictly observes chivalry etiquette. He is arrogant and has the self-esteem of a valley noble. He believed that trials by combat should be determined by skill, but he did not always see that power would decide who was qualified to draw the sword first.
Background: Vardis is a knight of the Vale who served as an important guard in the Eyrie and participated in judicial affairs. His reputation came from his martial arts, his family name, and his dedication to duty. Others will remember his defeats or victories, but those who really know him know better that he values ​​honor over safety.
